name: support-triage-train-v1
note: TRAIN examples for the limb to distil a spec from. Fully disjoint from the held-out eval set (support-triage-eval.json) — the limb never sees the eval probes.
task: Read a customer support message. Reply with ONLY a JSON object: {"category": one of refund|shipping|account|bug|other, "urgency": one of low|medium|high, "order": the order number as a string or "none"}. No prose.

examples.input: This blender caught fire on first use!! Order 7734. I want a refund TODAY and I'm reporting you to trading standards.
hi, when will my parcel arrive? order number 210. no hurry x
Two-factor codes stopped coming through and I present to the board in an hour. Please help NOW.
Minor thing — the dark mode toggle resets every time I refresh. Whenever you get a sec.
Item from order 4520 arrived but it's the wrong colour. Not fussed about speed, just want it swapped or refunded.
What are your opening hours over the bank holiday?
Tracking for order 66 hasn't moved in 9 days and it's a birthday present for Saturday. Getting worried.
Your invoice download gives a 500 error and my accountant needs it for the VAT deadline tomorrow.
Please close my account and delete my data. No rush, just confirm when done.
Order 88 — box was empty when it arrived?! Where is my stuff?
